approvalEvent.summary: Approve Visual System V1 as the visual language AI Council will develop. This approval closes conceptual visual-system searching but does not claim that the fully interactive, responsive production system is finished.

humanReviewFindings: Hybrid V1 reads as one coherent system rather than a mixture of three prior worlds.
Conversation remains the primary product surface.
Project Home remains a continuation surface rather than a dashboard.
Decision Detail expresses durable project judgment and semantic lineage clearly.
Threshold consequence language remains isolated to genuine authority boundaries.
Long, code-heavy, evidence-heavy, tool, error, streaming, and long-memory stress states remain usable.
Working-state language reflects observable lifecycle state rather than fake internal thought.
productionRefinementRisks: Test metadata legibility on Windows, lower-density displays, zoom, Android tablets, and vision-accessibility settings.
Test intermediate conversation densities, not only sparse and deliberately dense extremes.
Prove right-inspector selected, hover, keyboard-focus, notification, loading, empty, long-content, tablet, and mobile-drawer states.
Complete iconography and production interaction proof before final visual-system approval.

approved: Newsreader for considered judgment rather than continuous long-form body copy
Inter for working interface and dense reading
IBM Plex Mono for literal code and machine material only
adaptive density behavior for evidence, code, tools, and memory
notFinal: exact typography metrics and every font weight
